recommendation.rule: Prefer simple entropy unless D or combination improves common-domain AP with case CI>0 and >=6/8 positive paired cases, without lowering global boundary recall at5%. C if no stable advantage over boundary prior or top10% recall<50% for >=50 high-confidence errors/farFP. These are exploratory gates, not clinical thresholds.
recommendation.interpretation: 优先采用单指标作小预算排序；没有组合全面优于它的证据。组合在较大预算下的覆盖优势仍需保留，R1须按病例独立验证。
